# Tumor form correlation with luminal ratio

```{r}
# Define the threshold for the Luminal fraction.
luminal_fraction_threshold <- 0.6

# The Luminal fraction is the Luminal score among the Luminal and Myo scores.
# This definition is used throughout the notebook.
deconv_result$luminal_fraction <- deconv_result$Luminal / (deconv_result$Luminal + deconv_result$Myo)

# Filter out samples with missing histopathology and join the deconvolution scores.
df_clinical_for_analysis <- dk_clinical %>%
  filter(FORM != "dataMissing") %>%
  left_join(deconv_result, by = c("UID" = "Mixture"))

```



```{r}
# set  high and low luminal ratio categories based on the threshold
df_clinical_for_analysis <- df_clinical_for_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    LumCategory = ifelse(luminal_fraction > luminal_fraction_threshold, paste("High (>", luminal_fraction_threshold, ")"), paste("Low (<=", luminal_fraction_threshold, ")"))
  )

my_colors <- c(
  "Solid" = "red",
  "Tubulocribriform" = "deepskyblue"
)

df_clinical_for_analysis$FORM <- factor(df_clinical_for_analysis$FORM, levels = c(
names(my_colors)
))


ggplot(df_clinical_for_analysis, aes(x = LumCategory, fill = FORM)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +  
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Histopathology by Luminal Ratio Category",
    x = "Luminal Ratio Category",
    y = "Proportion"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

# correlations between cell types

## combine clinical and deconvolution results
```{r}
all_clinical = rbind(tx_clinical,dk_clinical)
all_clinical_with_deconv = inner_join(all_clinical,deconv_result,by = c("UID" = "Mixture")) %>% as.data.frame()
```

# Calculate immune-cell and T-cell subtype fractions
```{r}

deconv_fractions <- calculate_deconv_fractions(all_clinical_with_deconv)

```

# The fraction calculations above replace the former duplicate aggregation blocks.


# Correlations among cell fractions
```{r}

cells_to_include <-  c(
    paste0(names(default_deconv_cell_sets()$t_cell_subtypes), "_fraction"),
    "treg_fraction",
    "luminal_fraction"
  )

fraction_columns <- intersect(
 cells_to_include,
  names(deconv_fractions)
)
correlation_data <- deconv_fractions[, fraction_columns, drop = FALSE]
```



```{r}
# Calculate and print the correlation matrix for inspection.
correlation_matrix <- print_deconv_correlation(
  correlation_data,
  columns = fraction_columns
)

```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=15}


p <- plot_deconv_correlations(
  correlation_data,
  columns = fraction_columns,
  title = "Pearson",
  text_size = 14
)
col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("royalblue4", "white", "red"))
lgd = Legend(title = "Pearson", col_fun = col_fun, legend_width = unit(8, "cm"), title_position = "topcenter",grid_width = unit(1, "cm"), title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14), labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14))


```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 10
plot_code_to_send <- function() {
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(p, padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 50), "mm"), column_title = "Brayer et al. (Denmark)", column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20))
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(lgd, x = unit(0.85, "npc"), y = unit(0.85, "npc"))

}

plot_code_to_send()
```

```{r}
svg_filename <- "brayer_cibersort_heatmap.svg"
svglite::svglite(file.path(params$data_out_dir, svg_filename), width = 10, height = 6)
plot_code_to_send()
dev.off()

```

# MI

```{r}
library(infotheo)
df_cells <- correlation_data 


df_discrete <- discretize(df_cells)


mi_matrix <- mutinformation(df_discrete)


mi_matrix <- as.matrix(mi_matrix)
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
heatmap(mi_matrix, col = colorRampPalette(c("white", "blue", "red"))(100), 
        main = "Mutual Information Heatmap", xlab = "Cell Types", ylab = "Cell Types", show_heatmap_legend = T)
```

# cox

```{r}
# Add survival outcomes to the same data frame used by the Cox models.
deconv_fractions <- deconv_fractions %>%
  mutate(
    os_status = if_else(STATUS == "Alive", 1, 0),
    os_time = as.numeric(SURV_MO)
  )
# deconv_fractions <- deconv_fractions %>%
#   filter(STAGE != "unk", !is.na(STAGE))
```

```{r}
library(survival)
coxph(Surv(os_time, os_status) ~ luminal_fraction, data = deconv_fractions) %>% summary()
coxph(Surv(os_time, os_status) ~ Treg, data = deconv_fractions) %>% summary()
coxph(Surv(os_time, os_status) ~ CAF, data = deconv_fractions) %>% summary()
coxph(Surv(os_time, os_status) ~ luminal_fraction + Treg, data = deconv_fractions) %>% summary()

```
```{r}
coxph(Surv(os_time, os_status) ~ luminal_fraction + Treg + STAGE, data = deconv_fractions)
```
